snippet.title: Coerced Cage FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Coerced Cage By Polyfization All Endings Horror Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Inspired by the pandemic lockdown, our main character goes through a period of isolation. Depending on player's choices, his mental state will result in 3 unique endings. Whether he escape his own house, or stay in for good... it is all up to you.

Coerced Cage: https://polyfization.itch.io/coerced-cage
Developer: Polyfization
Genres: Horror, RPG
Platforms: Microsoft Windows

0:00 Ending 1 Starve
3:25 Ending 2 Choke
4:36 Ending 3 Escape
